title: Grover's Algorithm — Amplitude Evolution
creator: EE 5340 Course Team, UMN
subject: Quantum Computing
Quantum Algorithms
Grover's Search
Amplitude Amplification
description: Step-through bar chart visualization of Grover's quantum search algorithm. Shows probability amplitudes for N=2^n states evolving over Grover iterations. Oracle flips sign of target state; diffusion reflects about mean. Users can adjust number of qubits (2-4), choose target state, and step through iterations to observe amplitude amplification and over-rotation.

learningObjectives: Observe how oracle and diffusion steps amplify the target state amplitude
Predict the optimal number of Grover iterations for N states
Explain why over-rotation reduces success probability
Connect amplitude amplification to quadratic speedup

technical.accessibility: ARIA describe() label, keyboard-accessible sliders and buttons
